## Rays Between Charged Plates

Scientists pass a high voltage through a glass tube that has almost no gas in it. Rays travel from the negative electrode, the **cathode**, towards the positive electrode, the **anode**, so they are called **cathode rays**. Now the rays pass between two charged metal plates, one positive and one negative.

**Predict:** Which way will the rays bend?

options.text: Towards the positive plate, because the rays carry negative charge.
Towards the negative plate, because the rays carry positive charge.
They will not bend at all, because the rays are a kind of light.
